status: Dated research proposal; not the current product contract
principle: More intelligence underneath should usually produce less interface on screen.

design_hypotheses.name: One stable Studio shell
design_hypotheses.idea: Keep navigation and primary controls predictable across work types. Adapt content relevance instead of moving the product grammar.
design_hypotheses.test: Run research, planning, writing, and analysis through the same shell and measure navigation errors and time to continue.

design_hypotheses.name: Progressive disclosure by default
design_hypotheses.idea: Show the smallest useful AI answer first, then reveal evidence, assumptions, memory, and history on demand or when risk requires it.
design_hypotheses.test: Compare a three-layer AI response with a full answer wall for scrolling, task success, confidence, and engagement.

design_hypotheses.name: Bounded Studio context
design_hypotheses.idea: Keep files, instructions, chats, decisions, tasks, and selected memory scoped to a Studio unless the user deliberately reaches outside it.
design_hypotheses.test: Expose a small editable context packet and test whether users can correct it quickly.

design_hypotheses.name: Artifact-first work
design_hypotheses.idea: The document, plan, checklist, analysis, task, or result remains the main surface. AI conversation is supporting UI.
design_hypotheses.test: Allow the AI panel to collapse completely while the current result stays understandable and editable.

design_hypotheses.name: Task-shaped sources
design_hypotheses.idea: Group active sources around the current work rather than recreating a flat browser or file list.
design_hypotheses.test: Measure open-tab count and time to retrieve a useful source before and after a Studio source shelf.

design_hypotheses.name: Resume before review
design_hypotheses.idea: When a Studio opens, show the previous outcome, next concrete action, and blocker before analytics or history.
design_hypotheses.test: Close work for 24 hours and measure time to correctly continue it.

design_hypotheses.name: Quiet memory
design_hypotheses.idea: Retrieve one to three memories only when they are likely to affect the current decision or action.
design_hypotheses.test: Measure useful memory reuse, dismiss rate, and perceived distraction.

design_hypotheses.name: Runs inside Studios
design_hypotheses.idea: Show recurring or agentic work inside the Studio it serves, with last result, next run, history, and exceptions.
design_hypotheses.test: Compare Studio-local run status with a separate automation dashboard for time to understand failures and outcomes.

frontier_radar.principle: Good proactive software should feel prepared, not impatient.

signals.name: Offer help before taking over
signals.finding: CHIWORK 2026 experiments found that unsolicited anticipatory AI help could increase self-threat and reduce willingness to accept help or use the system again.
signals.product_implication: Proactive AI should usually offer a small suggestion before acting automatically unless the action is low-risk and explicitly pre-approved.

signals.name: Intervene at workflow boundaries
signals.finding: A 2026 field study of proactive developer assistance found higher engagement at workflow boundaries and frequent dismissal for mid-task interventions.
signals.product_implication: Prefer suggestions at reopen, completion, pause, focus-end, blocker creation, or other natural boundaries.

signals.name: Recovery is part of interruption design
signals.finding: CHIWORK 2026 studied how activity context, timing, and individual differences shape perceived interruptibility and behavioral recovery.
signals.product_implication: Preserve a resume anchor whenever work is interrupted: current step, next action, blocker, and active evidence.

signals.name: Memory admission gate
signals.finding: 2026 research shows that semantic similarity can retrieve contextually inappropriate long-term memory that changes later agent behavior.
signals.product_implication: Filter candidate memory by Studio scope, provenance, sensitivity, age, task fit, and allowed use before it reaches model context.

signals.name: Ground truth under summaries
signals.finding: MemMachine reports benefits from preserving full episodes and improving retrieval rather than relying only on lossy extracted memory.
signals.product_implication: Treat summaries and context packets as views over durable source material and preserve traceability back to the original artifact or event.

signals.name: AI posture by task
signals.finding: Microsoft's 2026 Work Trend Index describes multiple patterns of human-AI work and emphasizes choosing the right pattern for the task.
signals.product_implication: Support a small set of AI postures such as Think, Collaborate, and Run without changing the Studio layout.

signals.name: Completion creates reusable learning
signals.finding: Microsoft frames strong AI-enabled organizations as learning systems that turn work output into reusable insight.
signals.product_implication: At meaningful completion, propose one sourced lesson, decision, preference, or reusable procedure for approval into memory.

signals.name: Context is a budget
signals.finding: Recent 2026 agent research suggests one useful layer of progressive disclosure can reduce context cost as knowledge collections grow.
signals.product_implication: Give AI a compact Studio catalog first and open detailed sources only when the current step needs them.

experiments: completion distillation into one approved lesson

evidence.topic: Progressive disclosure in generative AI search
evidence.finding: Progressive disclosure improved engagement and knowledge change while reducing extraneous cognitive demand in an exploratory-search experiment.
evidence.product_implication: Layer AI output instead of presenting one large response by default.

evidence.finding: Different adaptive menu designs produced different performance and preference outcomes; adaptation itself was not a universal improvement.
evidence.product_implication: Adapt relevance and suggestions while keeping core interface geometry predictable.

evidence.finding: Knowledge workers frequently struggled with excessive inactive tabs; supporting emerging structures between pages can reduce overload and improve focus.
evidence.product_implication: Organize sources by current work structure rather than a flat source list.

evidence.finding: ChatGPT Projects groups chats, files, instructions, and project memory so long-running work can continue without rebuilding the same context.
evidence.product_implication: Treat persistent bounded context as a core Studio capability.

evidence.finding: ChatGPT Work separates quick chat from longer multi-step work, can use project context, create finished artifacts, and lets users steer and approve actions.
evidence.product_implication: Keep quick help lightweight while giving deeper work a persistent Studio and artifact surface.

evidence.finding: A six-month randomized field experiment with more than 6,000 workers found less email time and somewhat faster document completion among AI-tool users, without a significant meeting-time change.
evidence.product_implication: Target friction around existing work before adding new work categories.

evidence.finding: Higher confidence in generative AI was associated with less reported critical-thinking effort, while critical thinking shifted toward verification, integration, and supervision.
evidence.product_implication: Important AI suggestions should expose evidence, assumptions, and approval points.

evidence.finding: Plan quality and user involvement both affected trust and team performance; plausible plans can still create misplaced trust.
evidence.product_implication: Use Plan -> Preview -> Approve -> Execute for higher-impact actions.

evidence.finding: Agentic support reduced workload, while medium autonomy gave the best balance of productivity and preference for control in the reported study.
evidence.product_implication: Set autonomy by risk, reversibility, and user preference rather than one global mode.

evidence.finding: AI-generated prototypes were rated positively for pragmatic qualities but weaker for originality and innovation.
evidence.product_implication: Use AI to implement the design system, not to define the product's visual identity by default.

rules: One primary action may be expressive.
Materials and transparency belong mainly to control layers, not content.
Color is never the only status signal.

anti_patterns: a separate dashboard for every capability
unsolicited proactive help in the middle of focused work
research_backlog: stable Studio shell across work types
measure useful work completed rather than AI activity
